caption: The drawing depicts a large, two-handled vase sketched in pencil on an off-white background. The vase has a wide, round body, a short, cylindrical neck, and two symmetrical handles, one on each side. On the front of the vase, there is a decorative element consisting of a necklace-like string of circular shapes arranged in a U-shape, suggesting beads or pearls, which hangs down from the neck. Within this string of circles and down the vase’s neck, several shaded patches appear. Beneath this beaded string, there are two leaf-shaped motifs, each containing a central line with small diagonal markings, and a smaller leaf motif below them. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the ornamental elements centered on the front of the vase. The lines are thin and consistent, with no color apart from the graphite of the pencil.
title: Grey Stoneware Water Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
